attribute_information.SPAD: Average SPAD value of 5 measured leaves at time of harvest.
attribute_information.closedflower_count: Number of closed flowers present on all inflorescences longer than 3cm at time of harvest.
attribute_information.cultivar: Cultivar each plant harvested belongs to.
attribute_information.flower_count: Number of flowers present on all inflorescences longer than 3cm at time of harvest.
attribute_information.height: Height of plant from the base of the plant just above soil to the tip of the growing point at time of harvest.
attribute_information.inflorescence_count: Total number of inflorescences longer than 3cm present on plant at time of harvest.
attribute_information.leaf_DW: Total weight of completely dried true leaves at time of harvest.
attribute_information.leaf_FW: Total weight of true leaves on plant at time of harvest.
attribute_information.leaf_area: Total leaf area of plant at time of harvest.
attribute_information.leaf_count: Total number of true leaves longer than 5cm present on plant at time of harvest.
attribute_information.node_count: Total number of nodes with either a leaf longer than 5cm or inflorescence longer than 3cm present on plant at time of harvest.
attribute_information.openflower_count: Number of open flowers present on all inflorescences longer than 3cm at time of harvest.
attribute_information.plant_ID: Individual plant identification tag, unique to each plant.
attribute_information.pot_size: Size of the pot each plant was grown in.
attribute_information.root_DW: Total weight of completely dried root tissue initially collected at time of harvest.
attribute_information.stem_DW: Total weight of completely dried stem tissue cut at the base of the plant just above soil with leaves removed at time of harvest.
attribute_information.stem_FW: Total weight of stem cut at the base of the plant just above soil with the leaves removed at time of harvest.

meta.description: Series of destructive measurements performed on tomato plants in order to gain valuable harvest data.
meta.name: Plant Destructive Harvest Data Collection
